entities.name: Jarin
entities.description: War chief of the Ghestos tribe of the Fallaji Empire under Mishra, a capable tactician who distrusted Ashnod.

events.summary: During Ashnod's campaign into Korlis, Jarin disobeys her direct orders, claiming he did not see the signal flag.
